method: Public SDK opens the retained published workflow definition, starts the unchanged missing-estimate source fixture, solves ready steps and prepares the native output. No calculated findings are injected. The fixture is unanswered, not an estimate of zero.

sdk.note: SHA-256 identifies the local SDK entry files used for this qualification; it is not a claim that every transitive dependency is archived here.

checks: All four release presets retain the same pinned published workflow definition.
Each changed release preset differs from the baseline by exactly the declared single fact.
Baseline: only extra-help passes, for $400 at minute 1020, preserving the original promise; no preference is declared.
Accepted scope: core-only and extra-help pass on different commitment bases.
Wrong build: no supplied arrangement passes the complete calculation.
Missing estimate: zero evaluations, needs-input and unknown summary; no infeasibility conclusion.
Restaurant transfer: only relief availability changes; two passing repairs become one coordinated repair.
Every displayed release result row matches the latest native planning output.
